title: Appeals, Course Reactivation and Closing Period: Level Schedule for Wayfare Driver Agreements
content:
Appeals, course reactivations and the closing of deactivated agreements under the **Driver Services Agreements and Account Standing** product use the figures below, which are the same on all six Wayfare levels.

| | Wayfare Standard | Wayfare Green | Wayfare Comfort | Wayfare XL | Wayfare Black | Wayfare Black SUV |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Appeal window after the deactivation date (calendar days) | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Deactivation reasons that may be appealed | cancellation rate; safety violation; fraud; background check | same four | same four | same four | same four | same four |
| Most appeals per deactivation | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Calendar days Wayfare takes to decide an appeal after it is submitted | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 | 10 |
| Rating deactivation reversible through the quality improvement course | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes | yes |
| Course reactivations allowed within 365 days | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| Calendar days after which a deactivated agreement not reactivated is closed | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 | 180 |

Not on the appealable list: a deactivation for rating below minimum and a deactivation for document lapse. On every level the rating case is reversible through the quality improvement course, as the table shows.

Hypothetical reading: an agreement deactivated on 2026-02-01 and never reactivated reaches the 180-day closing figure counted from that date.
